title: &aThe Builder's Wands
subtitle: Five wands, four cores, walls in an afternoon. RE:Constructed Wands.

quests.title: &aStone Before Iron
quests.subtitle: The masons' oldest trick.
description: The Crown's masons raised the Labyrinths with a wave of the hand. Their wands are dust, but the trick survived them: cobblestone, redstone and a stick make a &6Stone Wand&r.

Right-click the face of a block and the wand copies that face across every matching block behind it: a floor gets a layer, a wall gets thicker, a path gets wider. The outline shows what the next click will place, and turns red where you're short of blocks. A stone wand places up to &627&r a click and takes no cores.
&7Craft a Stone Wand.

quests.title: Know Your Wand
quests.subtitle: Read this before you wall in the river.
description: &6Sneak + right-click&r opens the wand's settings: mode, lock, direction, replace, match and random. Do it on a &6chest&r instead and the wand draws its blocks from that chest, from up to 64 blocks away. Shulker boxes, bundles and your Ender Chest feed it too.

&6Ctrl + scroll&r sets how many blocks a click places. &6Sneak + scroll&r locks a direction, or picks the Architect's shape. &6Ctrl + Z&r and &6Ctrl + Y&r undo and redo, ten steps deep; nothing is ever duplicated. &6Random&r mixes the blocks in your hotbar, for walls that look as old as the rest of the world.
&7The wand's own mode-wheel and settings keys are unbound in this pack (R is your weapon art, G the command wheel). Bind them in Controls if you want them.

quests.title: The Exchange Core
quests.subtitle: Cobblestone today, stone bricks tomorrow.
description: Stone wands take no cores. The &6Iron Wand&r you made for Last Light does: craft a core together with it and the core is installed.

Two emeralds, an ender pearl and glass panes make an &6Exchange Core&r. Exchange mode swaps a surface for the block in your offhand. Stairs and logs keep their facing, and the old blocks come back to you.
&7Craft an Exchange Core.

quests.title: The Angel Core
quests.subtitle: A block where there was only air.
description: Two &6Duskforged Ingots&r, a feather and glass panes: in this pack the &6Angel Core&r is built on the Ember Forge's second tier. Angel mode places a block in mid-air in front of you, or behind the block you click. Bridges over chasms, the first block of a tower. Not while you are falling; the wand has standards.
An iron wand reaches 4 blocks out, a diamond one 16.
&7Craft an Angel Core.

quests.title: The Destruction Core
quests.subtitle: Unbuilding, one surface at a time.
description: A block of diamond between two &6diamond pickaxes&r (each takes a Duskforged Ingot in this pack) and glass panes make a &6Destruction Core&r. Destruction mode removes the exposed surface of matching blocks, and the drops go straight to your inventory as if broken with the tool in your offhand: hold a Silk Touch pickaxe there and you keep the blocks themselves.
It leaves ores, spawners and bedrock alone.
&7Craft a Destruction Core.

quests.title: The Full Kit
quests.subtitle: One wand, five trades.
description: A wand holds every core at once. With Exchange, Angel, Destruction and the &6Architect Core&r you made for Last Light, one wand does five jobs; switch between them in the settings.
&7Install all four cores in one wand.

tasks.title: My wand holds all four cores

quests.title: &aThe Moonsilver Wand
quests.subtitle: A thousand blocks a click.
description: The pack rebuilt the &6Diamond Wand&r on the Ember Forge's third tier: a &6Moonsilver Ingot&r over redstone and a stick. It places up to &61,024&r blocks a click, reaches 16 blocks in Angel mode, clears or swaps 81 at a time, and lasts 1,561 uses. Wands mend in an anvil and take Unbreaking and Mending.
Craft your cores into it like before.
&7Craft a Diamond Wand.

quests.title: Stone by the Thousand
quests.subtitle: The Works dig. The wand builds.
description: A thousand blocks a click is a thousand blocks you have to own. The Ashen Works' &6Quarry&r brings stone and deepslate up by the chestful. Sneak + right-click the chest it fills and the wand builds straight out of the mine, from anywhere within 64 blocks.
&7Gather 512 Cobbled Deepslate.

quests.title: The Deepsteel Wand
quests.subtitle: Two thousand blocks, and it keeps what you taught it.
description: At a smithing table: a &6netherite upgrade template&r, your Diamond Wand and a &6Deepsteel Ingot&r (not netherite: the Forge's fourth tier took its place). The &6Netherite Wand&r keeps the cores you installed, places &62,048&r blocks a click, reaches 32 in Angel mode and clears or swaps 128.
Templates wait in the Ashlands' bastions.
&7Upgrade to a Netherite Wand.

quests.title: &aThe Infinity Wand
quests.subtitle: Walls for a world that gets its sun back.
description: &6The Keeper&r
&f&o"You set a splinter of the black sun on a stick so you could build faster. Good. Build them something worth the light coming back to."&r
An &6Eclipse Core&r over redstone and a stick makes the &6Infinity Wand&r: it never breaks, places 2,048 blocks a click and reaches 64 blocks in Angel mode.
&7Craft the Infinity Wand.
